title: Unique normalized identification of completed direct images
statement: For every prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, and scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, the functor sfCompletedModuleDirectImage [def-strict-coefficient-completed-image-data] is naturally isomorphic to the actual module direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] for the completed coefficient data [def-strict-coefficient-ringed-geometric-data, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. There is a unique such natural isomorphism whose component on every completed-coefficient module and pro-etale test object is the identity on underlying sections, expressed as heterogeneous equality.

source.place: Primitive tensor reassociation, evaluation and adjunction unit/counit comparisons; agent-formulated component of lem-sf-integral-basic-realization.

proof.text: The completed coefficient pull map is defined as the inverse image under the pro-etale sheaf adjunction hom-equivalence of sfCompletedCoefficientMap. Apply that equivalence back to recover sfCompletedCoefficientMap. Unfolding the two module direct-image constructions therefore proves equality of their functors.

Use the isomorphism induced by this functor equality. Equality transport on each module and section is the identity as a heterogeneous equality; prove this general assertion by equality induction. Thus the resulting comparison has the required section normalization.

For another normalized isomorphism, the two hom maps agree on every module, test object and section. Extensionality of sheaf-module maps and natural transformations gives equality of the hom maps, hence equality of the isomorphisms. This argument also covers zero modules, identity arrows and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: H8: completed direct-image identification in primitive realization Step 3; Stacks 03D1 and 0941.

lean.statement:
theorem integralCompletedDirectImageComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃! e : sfCompletedModuleDirectImage l E f ≅
      proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X) ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f),
      ∀ (N : scalarReductionSource l E X) (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : ((sfCompletedModuleDirectImage l E f).obj N).val.obj V),
        HEq ((e.hom.app N).val.app V x) x
